item.title: China, Canada reach ‘landmark’ deal on tariffs, visas
item.description: Canada’s Prime Minister Mark Carney and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed on a raft of measures from trade to tourism on Friday at the first meeting between the countries’ leaders in Beijing in eight years. item.title: Temperature to drop to 12 degrees Celsius next week, Observatory says
item.description: An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach Hong Kong next week, with temperatures forecast to drop to 12 degrees Celsius starting Wednesday, the Observatory has said. “An intense winter monsoon is expected to start affecting southern China gradually next Tuesday. item.title: HKFP Lens: Portuguese photojournalist Gonçalo Lobo Pinheiro’s sequel on Macau’s past and present
item.description: Portuguese photojournalist Gonçalo Lobo Pinheiro has published a sequel to his documentary project, “What once was, will be no more…,” which captures the shifting landscape of Macau by placing archival photographs within contemporary settings. item.description: Taiwan vowed Friday to remain the world’s “most important” AI chipmaker, after reaching a trade deal with the United States that will reduce tariffs on the island’s shipments and increase Taiwanese investment on US soil. item.description: Welcome back to HKFP Monitor. item.title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 66
item.description: In a landmark national security trial, a Hong Kong court convicted pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai of foreign collusion and sedition charges. The guilty verdict, delivered in mid-December, was lauded by Hong Kong and Beijing authorities but condemned by foreign governments and press groups. item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Hong Kong’s dwindling LGBTQ funding scheme mainly goes to groups with no ties to community
item.description: Five of the seven groups awarded funding under a government scheme for projects on sexual minorities have no track record of LGBTQ-related work, prompting concern among veteran activists about their effectiveness.
